title: Instant Crafting
description: Save time and unnecessary clicks by instantly crafting items directly from your recipe book.
body:
Craft items directly from your recipe book instantly, completely bypassing the need to manually move ingredients into the crafting grid slots first.

It serves as a massive time-saver and quality-of-life improvement, especially when bulk-crafting or quickly preparing gear. It takes the tediousness out of the vanilla crafting system.

## Features
The mod can be quickly enabled or disabled in-game at any time.

## Keyboard Shortcuts
"V" - Toggle Mod On/Off

## Information
If you install this mod only on your own (on the client) and the server does not have it installed, the mod will not work and the item will not be crafted immediately. You will only be able to toggle between on/off states, but the function itself will not be performed.
